name: route-update-lost
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). The first ROUTE_UPDATE (to relay B) is dropped on both of C's links, so no copy can reach B. The controller retries after its timeout; the route is shown active only after the acknowledgement of the retried update.
